title: Local representatives of constant field sheaf sections
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J and weak sheafification of commutative rings. Assume C is essentially small in an independent universe m. For a field kappa [def-weil-field], the unit from its constant ring presheaf to its associated constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] is locally surjective: each section is represented by field elements on a covering sieve. The site-object, morphism, field and smallness universes are independent; no enough-points assumption is imposed.

source.place: Sites, example-constant-sheaf (0H7J), associated-sheaf construction (00W1); Modules on Sites, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules (03CY); local-image subsheaf argument

proof.text: The forgetful functor from commutative rings preserves limits by its free-ring adjunction. It also reflects limits of arbitrary size: a limiting cone of underlying types makes the type of compatible sections small, hence the corresponding ring limit exists. Preservation and reflection of isomorphisms now reflect this particular limit.

Inside the underlying sheaf Q of the associated constant ring, take the sheaf closure G of the range of the unit (Mathlib Subfunctor.sheafify). Its sections form subrings: zero and one are in the image, addition and multiplication follow on intersected covers, and negation follows on the original cover. Restrictions preserve this subring.

Equip G with these sectionwise subrings to obtain a commutative-ring presheaf F. Its underlying type presheaf is G, a sheaf by Subfunctor.sheafify_isSheaf. Limit reflection for the forgetful functor proves that F is a ring-valued sheaf.

The unit factors through F. Extend this factorization from the constant presheaf to Q using the sheafification universal property. Composing the extension with the inclusion F to Q is the identity, by uniqueness of sheafification lifts. Every section of Q thus belongs to G, which is exactly local surjectivity of the unit.

theorem constantFieldUnit_locallySurjective
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [EssentiallySmall.{m} C] [HasWeakSheafify J CommRingCat.{r}]
    (κ : Type r) [Field κ] :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J
      (toSheafify J ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of κ)))
